name: openbb_derivatives_futures_curve
description:
Futures term structure (price by expiration) for one commodity or financial future from Yahoo Finance through the OpenBB Platform (obb.derivatives.futures.curve).
Returns: {tool, provider, data_points (rows before the cap), truncated, data: rows with their dates, ignored_arguments when some did not apply} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol (root, e.g. CL crude oil, GC gold, ES S&P 500; default CL); date (latest when omitted); limit (rows returned, 1-1000; default 100; a dated series keeps its most recent rows); provider (yfinance; default yfinance).
Price history of a contract: openbb_derivatives_futures_historical. Keys: yfinance needs none.
Example: {"symbol": "GC"}

symbol.description: Futures root, e.g. CL, GC, ES

date.description: Curve as of this date; latest when omitted (YYYY-MM-DD)

limit.description: Most rows returned (1-1000); a dated series keeps its most recent rows
